nodes.label: Hero banner image: two stacked isometric rounded-square 'card' shapes, the top one white with a thin grey outline, the bottom one filled with a purple/violet gradient with a subtle brushed-metal texture, connected by dashed vertical guide lines suggesting an exploded/layered 3D illustration. Minimalist, abstract, geometric style typical of modern SaaS/tech landing pages, likely used as the hero/banner illustration on the Sangam frontend landing page to convey layers, connection, or 'joining' visually.
